verdict.rationale: The evidence shows hosted checkout links, an embedded checkout, and Polar acting as Merchant of Record that "takes care of charging customers." None of it documents card tokenization, PCI DSS scope reduction, or that card data never reaches the merchant's servers. Hosted or embedded checkout surfaces are an adjacent feature that only implies this; the story's actual capability is unevidenced.

support.subject: As a developer, I can keep my systems out of most of PCI DSS scope because card data is tokenized and never touches my servers
